item.title: Legault bewildered by Trump's statement that China would stop hockey
item.description: "Sometimes we think (what Trump says) doesn't make sense, but sometimes he insists, so we have to be careful," Quebec's premier says after U.S. president rants about the Gordie Howe Bridge.

item.description: Premier François Legault confirmed $269 million in provincial funding for the campus's $356 million expansion project.

item.description: Change of heart on immigration pleases unions and mayors, but embarrasses minister Roberge, who backed her in CAQ leadership race.

item.title: Montreal man arrested for allegedly helping Ryan Wedding track informant to death
item.description: Tommy Demorizi, 35, is accused of helping Wedding’s organization locate Jonathan Acebedo Garcia, a Montrealer and FBI informant, by paying a Montreal-based reggaeton DJ up to $1,000 for his contact information.

item.description: The suspected shooter was found dead inside the school from an apparent self-inflicted injury, police said.
